title: Step 9b stops sending a kind of fault after its turns changed nothing on two pages; untried kinds still get their turns
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd (no database needed).
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: Four pages with only template picture faults whose turns end no-change: the first two run, the last two are skipped with code kind-unchanged and a reason naming demo-picture.
A later page with a picture fault and a template-words fault runs with the words fault only; when turns change something, every page runs and nothing is skipped.

tests: after two pages whose picture turns changed nothing, later pages get no turn for template pictures
a page keeps its turns for a kind not yet tried, and a turn that changed something does not count
